# apicurio_branch (Resource)

A branch of an artifact: an ordered list of its versions. The system branches `latest` (every non-draft version) and `drafts` are maintained by the registry and cannot be managed. `versions` is replaced as a whole on every change; when unset, the resource leaves the list alone and shows what the registry has. Deleting a version removes it from every branch.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# A branch is an ordered list of versions; `latest` and `drafts` are
# maintained by the registry itself and cannot be managed.
resource "apicurio_branch" "stable" {
  group_id    = apicurio_artifact.price.group_id
  artifact_id = apicurio_artifact.price.artifact_id
  branch_id   = "stable"
  description = "Versions approved for production"

  versions = [
    apicurio_artifact_version.v1.version,
    apicurio_artifact_version.v2.version,
  ]
}

# Without `versions` the branch is created empty and its list is left to
# other tooling (for example the `branches` of new versions).
resource "apicurio_branch" "nightly" {
  group_id    = apicurio_artifact.price.group_id
  artifact_id = apicurio_artifact.price.artifact_id
  branch_id   = "nightly"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `artifact_id` (String) Artifact the branch belongs to. Changing it replaces the branch.
- `branch_id` (String) Branch id (`[a-zA-Z0-9._-+]`, 1 to 256 characters); `latest` and `drafts` are reserved. Changing it replaces the branch.
- `group_id` (String) Group of the artifact. Changing it replaces the branch.

### Optional

- `description` (String) Description of the branch.
- `versions` (List of String) Version ids in branch order (oldest first, the way they were added). Every version must exist; duplicates are refused. Replaced as a whole when changed; unset leaves the registry's list alone.

### Read-Only

- `created_on` (String) Creation time (RFC 3339).
- `id` (String) `group_id/artifact_id/branch_id`.
- `modified_by` (String) User of the last modification.
- `modified_on` (String) Last modification time (RFC 3339).
- `owner` (String) Owner of the branch.
- `system_defined` (Boolean) Whether the registry maintains the branch itself (always `false` for a managed branch).

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Branches are imported by "group_id/artifact_id/branch_id".
terraform import apicurio_branch.stable payments/price/stable
```
